<module id="LIFObuffer">
    <description>A Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) buffer for temporary data storage.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="dataIn" width_description="[3:0]">Data input port.</input>
        <input id="RW">Read/Write control signal.</input>
        <input id="EN">Enable signal.</input>
        <input id="Rst">Active-high reset signal.</input>
        <input id="Clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <output id="EMPTY">Flag indicating if the buffer is empty.</output>
        <output id="FULL">Flag indicating if the buffer is full.</output>
        <output id="dataOut" width_description="[3:0]">Data output port.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="EMPTY_STATE">Buffer is empty.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DATA_PRESENT">Data present in buffer.</parameter>
        <parameter id="BUFFER_FULL">Buffer is full.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="EMPTY">((SP == 4'h4) && (stack_mem[SP][3] == 0)) ? 1 : 0;</assign>
        <assign id="FULL">((SP == 4'h0) && (stack_mem[SP][3] == 1)) ? 1 : 0;</assign>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        reg [3:0] SP;
        reg [3:0] stack_mem [3:0];
        
        always @(posedge Clk) begin
            if(EN==1) begin
                if(Rst==1)begin
                    SP <= 4'd4;
                    stack_mem[0] <= 4'd0;
                    stack_mem[1] <= 4'd0;
                    stack_mem[2] <= 4'd0;
                    stack_mem[3] <= 4'd0;
                end else begin
                    case({RW, SP})
                        {1'b0, 4'h4}: begin
                            stack_mem[SP]<=dataIn;
                            SP<=SP-1;
                        end
                        {1'b1, 4'h0}: begin
                            SP<=SP+1;
                            stack_mem[SP]<={4{1'b0}};
                        end
                        default: begin
                            SP<=SP;
                        end
                    endcase
                end
            end
        end
        
        always@(posedge Clk) begin
            if(EN==1) begin
                if(Rst==1)begin
                    SP <= 4'd4;
                    stack_mem[0] <= 4'd0;
                    stack_mem[1] <= 4'd0;
                    stack_mem[2] <= 4'd0;
                    stack_mem[3] <= 4'd0;
                end else begin
                    case({RW, SP})
                        {1'b1, 4'h0}: begin
                            SP<=SP+1;
                            stack_mem[SP]<={4{1'b0}};
                        end
                        default: begin
                            SP<=SP;
                        end
                    endcase
                end
            end
        end
        assign dataOut = stack_mem[SP];
    </implementation>
</module>
